Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehilce involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe what happened on the day of the collision?
A: I was driving in the right lane on the main road in Baytown, Texas, heading toward the interchange. I wanted to
move into the left lane because the traffic in my lane had slowed down. I checked my mirror, and I didn't see anynoe
right beside me, so I started to change lanes.
Q: Did you signal before changing lanes?
A: Yes, I turned on my signal and started to move over slowly.
Q: What happened next?
A: As I was moving over, another vehicle in the left lane came up alongside me and our driver's side and passenger
side scraped. It sounded like metal grinding. Both of us pulled onto the shoulder after that.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not until it was right next to me. It seemed to be coming up fast in my blind spot.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck snapped forward and back when we made contact, and I've had stiffness and pain since then. I've
also had headaches that come and go.
Q: Have you received any medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful, and I want my medical bills and vehicle repairs taken care of properly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
